create_simple_vit_model: create a SimpleViT model with register tokens for image classification using patch embedding and sincos positional encoding
build_transformer_encoder: build a Transformer encoder with stacked attention and feedforward layers for sequence processing
create_attention_layer: create a multi-head self-attention layer with LayerNorm and QKV projection for token interaction
create_feedforward_layer: create a feedforward MLP block with LayerNorm, GELU activation, and linear projections
generate_sincos_positional_embedding: generate 2D sine-cosine positional embeddings for a grid of height and width with given feature dimension
